scoring_dimensions.label: Buyer desire
scoring_dimensions.description: Would a real buyer pay to wear or gift this exact idea because of a concrete emotional/social trigger? Mere recognition of job vocabulary scores low.

scoring_dimensions.label: Clarity at glance
scoring_dimensions.description: Can a viewer quickly understand the human premise or punchline, not merely parse technical steps?

scoring_dimensions.label: Distinctiveness
scoring_dimensions.description: Is there an original point of view, joke, situation, identity signal or visual premise? Rare jargon by itself is not distinctiveness.

scoring_dimensions.label: Giftability
scoring_dimensions.description: Is there a plausible recipient/occasion and a reason a giver would choose this exact idea over generic profession merch?

scoring_dimensions.label: Insider resonance
scoring_dimensions.description: Does it capture a shared situation, frustration, pride point, ritual or truth insiders recognize? Jargon density alone does not count.

scoring_dimensions.label: IP safety
scoring_dimensions.description: Can the exact premise, wording and visual be executed without protected brands, slogans, characters, copied graphics or misleading claims?

scoring_dimensions.label: Niche fit
scoring_dimensions.description: Does the concept genuinely belong to this audience without depending on job-title labeling or vocabulary lists?

scoring_dimensions.label: Visual potential
scoring_dimensions.description: Can the human idea become a strong apparel composition rather than a diagram, checklist or training graphic?

scoring_dimensions.label: Channel breadth
scoring_dimensions.description: Usefulness beyond one marketplace/channel and fit with broader Town Label commerce/content.

scoring_dimensions.label: Competition opportunity
scoring_dimensions.description: Room for differentiated offers; higher means less commoditized/copycat pressure relative to demand.

scoring_dimensions.label: Concept depth
scoring_dimensions.description: How many materially different authentic hooks can be developed without repeating the same joke/text.

scoring_dimensions.label: Demand evidence
scoring_dimensions.description: Evidence that a real buyer population actively searches, buys, gifts or identifies with this niche.

scoring_dimensions.label: Founder/domain edge
scoring_dimensions.description: Advantage from first-hand knowledge, access, community understanding or easier validation.

scoring_dimensions.label: Identity intensity
scoring_dimensions.description: How strongly people self-identify with the niche and enjoy signaling membership.

scoring_dimensions.label: Legal/IP safety
scoring_dimensions.description: Relative ability to create without leaning on protected brands, logos, characters or risky claims.

scoring_dimensions.label: Purchase motivation
scoring_dimensions.description: Strength of plausible reasons to buy beyond generic job-title decoration.

scoring_dimensions.label: Repeatability
scoring_dimensions.description: Ability to support a series, variants, seasons, gifts or repeat purchase.

scoring_dimensions.label: Visual language
scoring_dimensions.description: Availability of recognizable symbols, tools, situations, environments and insider cues for strong art.

owner_explanation_v1.line_meaning: The technician investigates one job and uncovers a deeper pre-existing problem. From the outside it can look as though the technician caused the new problem simply because it was discovered while they were working.

concept_revisions.title: Cytology — obscure profession club
concept_revisions.concept_text: Use the fact that even healthcare peers often do not know what a cytotech is.
concept_revisions.hook: NOBODY KNOWS WHAT A CYTOTECH IS. WE KNOW.
concept_revisions.purchase_reason: Hidden-tribe identity and solidarity; easy gift from/for coworkers.
concept_revisions.differentiation: The joke is social obscurity, not a vocabulary lesson.
concept_revisions.visual_direction_text: Secret-club badge made from a microscope field, not generic medical iconography.

editorial_disposition_v1.meaning: retained in the v4 research bank but not promoted into the 10-concept owner review packet

purchase_trigger_gate_v2.expected_insider_reaction: Cytotechs feel seen because obscurity itself is part of the culture.
purchase_trigger_gate_v2.human_idea_without_profession: The human premise is belonging to a skilled group most people have never heard of.

concept_revisions.concept_text: Calibration Technician professional metrology graphic. Preferred research proof C: CALIBRATION TECHNICIAN / MEASUREMENT CONTROL with REFERENCE — UUT — RESULT, MEASURE • COMPARE • VERIFY • RECORD, and UNCERTAINTY • TOLERANCE • REPEATABILITY.
